Great to meet today — thanks for the time and the clear rundown on your integration needs. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive and make the best use of engineering time:

  Wave B (Week 2): 22:00–23:00 PT / 06:00–07:00 CET / 13:00–14:00 SGT (APAC-friendly)
  Wave C (Week 3): 12:00–13:00 PT / 20:00–21:00 CET (midday US, evening EU)

We can run the first deep dive in whichever wave works for your key attendees, then keep subsequent sessions on the rotation (or pause if you prefer ad-hoc).

Please reply with which of these waves works for the primary technical attendees (network/security lead + infra architect). If you'd like, use this scheduling link to show availability across your team: https://cal.com/redwood/demo-waves?slot=xyz
